messages:
mia: Hi team — our baby via surrogacy arrived last week 🎉. Im trying to add them to benefits but the birth certificate lists the gestational carrier and not our names yet. What docs will you accept for enrollment?

sasha - People Ops: Congrats, mia! :tada: For surrogacy we usually accept one of these (choose what you have):
- Court-issued parentage/parental order naming you as the legal parent(s)
- Hospital letter + intended parent agreement or surrogacy contract (if court order is pending)
- Amended birth certificate once it lists you

Also need child's DOB and SSN when available. Please upload to the HR portal > Benefits > Dependent Docs (category: "Newborn - Surrogacy"). Link: https://hr.redwood.example.com/upload

peopleops_bot: Case created: BP-3489. A People Ops rep will follow up within 2 business days.

jamal: Timeline Q — if the court order takes months, can we get provisional coverage or retro coverage?

sasha - People Ops: Good question. You have 60 days from the child's DOB to add them as a QLE. If official docs will be delayed, upload provisional docs (hospital letter + surrogacy agreement) within the 60-day window and mark as "pending court order." We can provisionally enroll the dependent and apply retro premium adjustments once final docs are provided. If the submission misses the 60-day window, we can file an exception request with the carrier but approval is not guaranteed.

alex: For payroll—is premium prorated if enrollment happens mid-month?

sasha - People Ops: Yes. Premiums prorate based on the coverage effective date. If enrollment is mid-pay-period, youll see a prorated deduction on the next payroll run. We confirm the effective date when you submit documents.

mia: Our names are different from the carrier on the hospital paperwork. Will that block us?

sasha - People Ops: Thats okay. Upload the hospital letter plus the surrogacy contract showing intended parents and any interim legal filing. If the carrier later requires a court order, well replace provisional docs with the final order. If you want faster handling, DM me the case number and Ill flag it for priority review.

jamal: Adding for others to see — thanks @sasha - People Ops :thumbsup:

mia: Uploading files now. Thanks everyone!

peopleops_bot: Reminder: redact any banking/payment info before uploading.
